interface.title: hplcsim — Cockpit
interface.field: Analytical chemistry: reversed-phase HPLC method development
interface.stage_of_work: Method development and optimisation, after two scouting gradient runs and before injecting a candidate gradient
interface.what_it_is_for: Fit a two-point LSS retention model (log10 k0, S) per peak from two scouting gradients, then predict retention times, widths and resolution for a candidate gradient programme, with diagnostics showing how far each prediction extrapolates past the calibrated composition window.

data.note: I loaded three-peak-session.json through the sidebar's 'Load a session' uploader. It carries the method constants, a 0.9375 min dwell, the tG 15/45 scouting runs with three peaks, and a 25 min candidate ramp. Before that, I typed a 0.35 mL dwell by hand to unlock the empty main view. The app has no input for the measured run3/run4 files, which are CSV, and the uploader takes JSON only.

features.name: Two-point calibration fit with per-item quality notes
features.general: Enter paired measurements of the same items from two calibration experiments, fit a two-parameter model per item, and read per-item parameters, the efficiency source and refusal reasons, plus warnings when the two experiments are too close together
features.specific: Peak table (tR/area/W½ for run 1 and run 2) plus the Scouting table: Fit parameters gives log10 k0, S, N, 'N from', the N run 1/run 2 ratio and a Note per compound; a β warning appears when the scouting tGs are too close
steps: type or paste one row per compound with tR in both runs
optionally add areas and W½
open Fit parameters
read log10 k0/S/N per peak and any refusal note
adjust the scouting tG and see the fit accept or refuse

features.name: Pairing consistency check across runs
features.general: Compare each item's share of the total signal between two runs and flag rows whose share shifts past a threshold, as a sign of mispairing or bad integration
features.specific: Area-share tracking check: a yellow warning when a compound's area share moves more than 30% between scouting runs
steps: enter areas for both runs
read the warning naming the compound and its share change
correct the area or pairing
see the warning clear or move to another row
serves_tasks: Spot pairing or integration problems between the two runs

features.specific: 'Candidate — predicted' t (min)/%B data editor with an add-row button, a summary line (e.g. '5→95 %B · tG 49.5 min · hold 0.5 min · 2 segments'), a warning for rows earlier than the row above, and a Reset button

press Reset to return to one ramp over the scouting range

features.specific: Packing architecture dropdown (Fully porous / Core–shell) plus the t0 source radio (Measured marker / Geometry estimate), which fills t0 with 'ε_total·V_col/F' and a band.
